summary: Add focused sketch-diagnosis practice for the Boltzmann tail error identified by examiners.

improvements.why: ER 9701 s21 P22 Q3 reports higher-temperature sketches whose high-energy tails turn upward; the current sketch item asks for features but does not require diagnosing this error.
improvements.what: One exam-style short item presenting a verbal description of a student's higher-temperature Boltzmann sketch with a lower, right-shifted peak but an upturn at the far right. Ask the learner to identify and correct the faulty tail: it should approach the energy axis as energy increases, not rise again. Give a precise rubric, explanation and three progressive hints.
